{{Otheruses|Fox}}
The '''fox''' was a creature known to the [[Coynite/Legends|Coynites]]. [[Kaine Paulsen]] earned the Coynite nickname "Chu'la" or "the mighty, little fox who will not be caught."

The word "fox" was often used in the names of independent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that operated throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SS">{{GamerCite|1|Shipbuilding Secrets}}</ref>
